## Stripe failed-payment recovery
When a card payment on a Stripe invoice or subscription fails, the customer gets a friendly email (and optional SMS) with a link to fix it, and you get an alert.

**Setup (10 min)**
1. Connect a Stripe credential (secret key) on the trigger. n8n registers the webhook in Stripe when you activate, so n8n must be reachable from the internet.
2. Fill in **Config** and connect Gmail.
3. SMS optional: connect Twilio and set **sms_enabled = true**, or deactivate "Send SMS".
4. Use **test_mode = true** while testing; Stripe's "Send test webhook" works for this.

Tip: switch off Stripe's own failed-payment emails (Settings → Billing → Customer emails) if you want only these.

assignments.name: customer_subject
assignments.value: Your payment to {business_name} did not go through

assignments.name: customer_body
sms_template
assignments.value: {business_name}: your payment of {amount} did not go through. Update your details here: {payment_link} Reply STOP to opt out.

meta.description: Emails and texts customers a fix-your-card link when a Stripe invoice payment fails, and alerts the owner.
